summary: The runtime health classifier, read-only status/runtime/detail surfaces, worker recovery decisions, and required validation commands are present and passing, but the saved plan is not fully satisfied because planned API/worker regression coverage is still missing.
gaps: Add an API metrics regression in tests/unit/api/test_metrics_capacity.py for /v1/metrics/resources/saturation that injects a runtime_health_summary_provider and asserts runtime_health.stranded_count, fail_candidate_count, recoverable_count, and reason_counts serialize correctly; the endpoint shape changed but only service-level metrics coverage exists.

Add a worker regression for a monitoring_pr workspace with pr_url and an expired monitor claim proving runtime-stranding recovery clears the stale claim and the workspace can be claimed/resumed by the PR monitor loop; the current runtime-stranding test records the recoverable event but uses no claim and disables monitor dispatch.
